scenes.say: Why does the last race of the season start in daylight and finish in the dark?
In two thousand nine this was the first Formula One race to start in daylight and finish under floodlights.
There's no room by the first corner, so the pit lane exit dives into a tunnel under the track.
In twenty twenty-one the track was reshaped. The slow chicane went, and twenty-one corners became sixteen.
The finale runs fifty-eight laps, more than three hundred kilometres.
Watch the Abu Dhabi finale live on the LapRadar 3D map.

title: Abu Dhabi: a sunset finale and a pit lane that dives under the track
